en: Black-and-white image of a large Romanesque cathedral or church seen from a courtyard behind an iron fence with pointed arches. The building features tall, plain stone walls with narrow arched windows, a series of decorative arcades, and a prominent multi‑story octagonal tower with round-arched openings. In the courtyard there is a small, canopy-like structure resembling a baptistery or shrine. No printed text is visible on the front of the card.
